## About
Hank Sterwerf started Hank's Auto Body in a converted mechanical shop and gas station on Pippin Road in Colerain Township. Over the years the shop grew to add a frame shop, more work bays and a dedicated refinishing area with a Blowtherm downdraft paint booth and bake oven.
We're still a family owned and operated business, and we keep updating our equipment, like the Chief Velocity digital measuring system we use for frame repairs. We like a hands on, personal approach to every repair, whether you've been coming to us for years or it's your first visit.
Not sure about us yet? Ask a neighbor, call your insurance agent, or read what customers say. We're rated 4.8 from 109 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Full service auto body work after an accident, from estimate to finished repair.
- Frame measuring and aligning: Measuring and aligning frames after a collision.
- Color matching and tinting
- Body sheet metal repair: Repair and replacement of damaged body panels.
- Paintless dent removal: Dents taken out without repainting when the damage allows it.
- Glass replacement and repair
- A/C replacement and repair
- Suspension repair and wheel alignment: Suspension repair and replacement, including 4 wheel alignments.
- Detailing and buffing
- Custom striping and decals: Custom tape, painted striping or decaling.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We have an established relationship with all major insurance companies. One reviewer mentioned that we handled all the insurance paperwork.

Q: Can you match the paint on my car?
A: Yes. We can match any finish on any car using BASF's Color Max system and our in-house paint mixing facility.

Q: My car can't be driven. Can you help with towing?
A: Yes, we can arrange towing to the shop.
